name: Measure-Theoretic Relaxation Framing
description: Replaced explicit algebraic subsystem scheduling inequalities with the equivalent mathematical existence of contiguous intervals satisfying measure, precedence, and density bounds. This forces the model to deduce that the existence of such intervals reduces exactly to the scalar boundary checks `p1 + p2 > T` and `sum(p) > T`, defeating surface-level pattern-matching on the isolated contradictions.
